industries.name: Pet supply
industries.description: A fast-selling canned cat food has been out of stock for weeks, so its true demand is hidden; watch the suggestion correct for it.

industries.name: Wine & liquor
industries.description: A seasonal mulled wine is suddenly selling three times faster than its 90-day average, and the house red magnum sold out a month into the window.

industries.name: Specialty food
industries.description: Fresh cheese and bread are ordered weekly with short lead times, while a lavender honey only comes in cases that would last almost three months.

industries.name: Hardware
industries.description: Picture-hanging kits sold steadily until they ran out two months ago, and bulk materials come from a yard that takes ten days and ships every two weeks.

industries.name: Bike shop
industries.description: Patch kits sold out a month into the window and never came back, while complete bikes sell a couple of times a month and should not be reordered by the case.

industries.name: Gift shop
industries.description: Replenished staples like birthday cards and candles sit next to one-off maker pieces that sold once and should not be reordered automatically.
